title: DataViz Protocols for Wet-Lab Scientists
summary: Three connected, source-faithful visualization protocols using exact experimental tables, calculations, and byte-for-byte canonical PNGs: fluorescent-protein spectra, a differential-expression volcano plot, and CFP/YFP co-expression correlations.

source.title: DataViz protocols - An introduction to data visualization protocols for wet lab scientists
source.note: Each notebook is deliberately bounded to a source-produced plot-ready table and its corresponding analysis. All CSVs and final PNGs are byte-for-byte copies from the pinned source revision; no synthetic data, redrawn figures, or substituted analysis paths are used.
